value.answer: A sore throat with fever after a sibling's strep could be strep, but many sore throats at this age are viral, and I can't tell which from here. A throat swab from your doctor is worth getting, since antibiotics help if it is strep. Rest and fluids meanwhile.
value.triage: Call 811 or your doctor today if there is a rash, poor drinking, or it lasts over 2 days. Call 911 or go to the ER now for trouble breathing, drooling or can't swallow, stiff neck, or being very hard to wake.
